subject: Observability delivery checkpoints & runbook draft
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sam Jensen <sam.jensen@greenfield.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability delivery checkpoints & initial timeline

Hi Sam / Maya —

As discussed in last week's kickoff, attaching a concise set of delivery checkpoints for the observability workstream so we have alignment before the implementation sprint. High-level goals:

- Wire tracing hooks into ingress + LLM inference paths
- Deliver three dashboards (latency, error taxonomy, cost per-request)
- Implement alert routing and ownership for severity P0/P1/P2
- Publish a lightweight runbook (on-call steps + mitigation playbooks)

I've put together a checkpoint spreadsheet (attached) that maps deliverables to owners and acceptance criteria. Please review the milestones and call out any constraints (e.g., data retention policy, retention windows, or export restrictions) you need us to respect.

Attachments: [Attachment: delivery_checkpoints.xlsx (XLSX)]

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm the three dashboard KPIs and chart owners by EOD Wed 5/29.
2) We'll deliver a runbook draft for review by Fri 5/31.
3) Schedule a 60-min knowledge transfer for runbook + tracing on Mon 6/3.

Thanks — happy to pivot timelines if you have a compliance gating item.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference runtime

From: Sam Jensen <sam.jensen@greenfield.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Lopez <maya.lopez@greenfield.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 May 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability delivery checkpoints & initial timeline

Thanks Laura — this looks good. A few quick questions before we lock dates: 

1) Data residency: our legal team requires that logs containing any PII be retained no longer than 30 days and that trace IDs with user identifiers are masked before export. Can you confirm Redwood's default retention and masking options for Dedicated customers?

2) Dashboards: for the latency dashboard we want p50/p95/p99 across both the API and our internal batch pipeline. Can the dashboard pull from both sources or should we standardize on the API-only signal?

3) Runbook scope: can the draft include a short decision matrix for when to fallback to a smaller model (cost/latency tradeoff) — this will help our SREs during incidents.

We can confirm KPIs by Wed; also, Maya would like a short readout with the infra team before the knowledge transfer. Are you able to include an infra-facing 30-minute pre-brief on Mon 6/3 at 10:00am PT?

Sam Jensen
Head of ML Platform, Greenfield AI
sam.jensen@greenfield.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability delivery checkpoints & initial timeline

Laura — answered Sam's items inline, and added notes for the runbook decision matrix.

1) Data residency/masking: Dedicated customers can set retention windows per-signal; default is 90 days but we can configure 30 days for traces with PII. We also support field-level redaction at ingestion and a masking pipeline before exports. For GF we should propose: traces retained 30d, metrics 365d, and export masking enabled. I'll attach a short evidence packet if they want SOC/architecture notes.

2) Dashboards across API + batch: we can map both sources into a single dashboard by using a semantic dimension ("ingest_source") — front-end allows filtering by source. We'll stitch the batch metrics through our ingestion adapter; there will be an expected ~30s ETL lag.

3) Runbook decision matrix: suggest a simple table with triggers (p95 latency > 1.2s, error rate > 2%) and recommended fallbacks (reduce model size, switch to cached response tier, temporarily throttle non-critical endpoints). I'll draft the rows and put in the runbook.

Attachments: [Attachment: SOC2_Ingestion_Notes.pdf (PDF)]

Also: aligns with INF-9123 (I'll add our implementation subtasks).

Ben
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sam Jensen <sam.jensen@greenfield.ai>, Maya Lopez <maya.lopez@greenfield.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 May 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Observability delivery checkpoints & runbook draft (v0.9)

Hi Sam / Maya —

Thanks for the quick replies and the constraints — we've updated the checkpoint sheet and attached a runbook draft (v0.9). Highlights:

- Retention/masking: runbook lists the agreed config and how to enable field-level redaction in Dedicated.
- Dashboards: combined API+batch latency dashboard with a note on ETL lag; owners assigned (GF: Maya / Redwood: Ben).
- Decision matrix: included a 3-row table with thresholds and fallback actions.
- Alert routing: mapping for P0/P1/P2 with Slack escalation + PagerDuty playbook references.

Attachments: [Attachment: Greenfield_Observability_Runbook_v0.9.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: delivery_checkpoints.xlsx (XLSX)]

Could you confirm the retention/masking proposal and whether the infra pre-brief on Mon 6/3 10:00am PT works for your team? If so I'll lock the calendar and prepare a 20-slide infra-oriented deck for that session.

Best,
Laura
